**Autonomous Development Checklist** (for maintainers):

Before adding `autonomous-ready` label, verify:
- [ ] Scope is clear and well-defined
- [ ] No design decisions required
- [ ] Can be completed in <1 hour
- [ ] Self-contained with all context provided
- [ ] Safe to automate (reversible, low risk)
